items.story: 'ലീവ് ഇന്ത്യ' നോട്ടീസിനെതിരെ നടൻ ഇമ്രാൻ ഖാൻ ബോംബെ ഹൈക്കോടതിയിൽ; എഫ്ആർആർഒ നടപടി ഭരണഘടനാ വിരുദ്ധമെന്ന് ഹർജി Jaihind Newsഇന്ത്യ വിടാൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടുള്ള നോട്ടീസിനെതിരേ ഹൈക്കോടതിയെ സമീപിച്ച് ഇമ്രാൻ ഖാൻ; റദ്ദാക്കണമെന്ന് ആവശ്യം Mathrubhumiഇന്ത്യ വിടണമെന്ന് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടുള്ള നോട്ടീസിനെതിരെ നടൻ ഇമ്രാൻ ഖാൻ ബോംബെ ഹൈക്കോടതിയെ സമീപിച്ചു News18 Malayalamഗ്യാനേഷ് കുമാറിനെതിരായ പ്രതിഷേധം; ഒക്ടോബർ 28നകം ഇന്ത്യ വിടണമെന്ന നോട്ടീസിനെതിരെ ഇമ്രാൻ ഖാൻ കോടതിയിലേക്ക് Reporter Tv'ഇന്ത്യ വിടാന്‍' മുംബൈ പോലിസ് നല്‍കിയ നോട്ടി

items.story: Astronomers using China's FAST radio telescope have discovered a compact cloud of hydrogen with no visible stars or galaxy around it. The discovery paper was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Sept. 24.

items.headline: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope exceeds expectations by nearly 30%

items.story: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has exceeded expectations after engineers made incredibly tiny adjustments to sharpen its view of the universe. By moving a mirror just one-sixteenth the width of a human hair, the team helped bring its powerful instruments into near-perfect alignment. Roman’s Wide Field Instrument now produces image quality nearly 30% better than predicted, promising exceptionally sharp cosmic surveys.

items.story: SpaceX just delivered some surprisingly strange cargo to the International Space Station, including tiny brain models, 3D heart tissue, and technology for making artificial retinas in space. The shipment also includes materials for creating unusual glass in near weightlessness and the station’s final upgraded solar arrays.

items.story: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have discovered that a distant alien planet's atmosphere is surprisingly lopsided. A groundbreaking new mapping technique revealed these hidden distortions, confirming predictions about how extreme temperatures and winds shape alien worlds.

items.story: ఐపీఎల్ 2027.. ఢిల్లీ క్యాపిటల్స్‌ బౌలింగ్‌ కోచ్‌గా చమిందా వాస్‌ AndhrajyothyYuvraj Singh: ఢిల్లీ కోచ్‌గా యువీ ఎంట్రీ.. సన్‌రైజర్స్‌ ప్లేయర్‌కు గాలం.. మొదలైన వణుకు.. ఇదేం టెన్షన్ రా బాబు! News18 Teluguఫాస్ట్‌ బౌలింగ్‌ కోచ్‌గా శ్రీలంక దిగ్గజం.. ప్రకటన విడుదల SakshiChaminda Vaas: ఢిల్లీ క్యాపిట‌ల్స్ బౌలింగ్ కోచ్‌గా చామిండ వాస్‌ Namasthe Telanganaగంగూలీ, యువరాజ్, వాస్.. ఢిల్లీ క్యాపిటల్స్‌కు కొత్త రూపు AP7AM
